note: Daily posting volume per channel, climbing one stage every stage_days from start (owner 2026-10-16: IG / the other networks post far too little). Read by 00_GrowthEngine shorts/scripts/schedule_posts.py (how many clip slots a day to plan, which slots first) and by .github/scripts/clip_posts.py / store_shot_cards.py (the day's allowance at post time). Auto-throttle (volume_ramp.py): a rate-limit, spam or action-block answer from a platform drops that channel one stage (ceiling) for hold_days, records the event here and opens a volume-throttle GitHub issue; after the hold the climb resumes one stage per stage_days from the ceiling. Threads stays at the owner's 3-a-day cap (clips: the 01:40 slot plus the 13:00 fallback) and is never raised. Mastodon posts nothing (account locked).
